diaspora_bullets: A 2036 Ahmedabad Games would be India's first Olympics
Ahmedabad has already secured the 2030 Commonwealth Games
hook_line: INDIA PITCHES TO HOST THE 2036 OLYMPICS

hook_stat.sub: The Games India is bidding to host for the first time

news_summary: India presented its bid to host the 2036 Olympic Games to the IOC's Future Host Commission on November 26, centring the pitch on Ahmedabad and a record of 36 international competitions hosted since January 2025.
payoff: The IOC is not due to select its preferred hosts until mid-2029.

stats.label: International competitions hosted across more than 15 cities between January 2025 and June 2026
